summary: Iteration 4 testing: Setup wizard, Backup/Restore, Dashboard Upcoming panel with flagged items, Backup button visibility, Library series add/remove flow, Podcast info settings. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (12 pytest cases, all passing). Backend covers: GET /api/setup/status returns needs_setup=false, POST /api/setup -> 409 when users exist, POST /api/setup/restore -> 409 when users exist, GET /api/backup is admin-only (producer 403) and returns valid zip with manifest app='bible-bytes-producer' and all 8 collection db/*.json files + admin user, POST /api/backup/restore rejects invalid zip (400), wrong-app manifest (400), and backup with no admin user (400 'admin'), series/{id}/episodes creates plan item + membership and MOVES to new series (single plan item), /series/remove-episodes clears membership, invalid series_id 404, podcast info fields (show_tagline, host_names, show_description, audience) persist on PUT /api/settings and are returned in /api/settings/public, /api/plan hydrates linked episode info correctly for date-range queries used by Upcoming panel. End-to-end setup wizard verified via Playwright: wiped mongo users (count 20->0), setup-page rendered, 'Start fresh' flow filled admin wizadmin/<redacted> + podcast info + Gemini default -> finish redirects to Dashboard logged in as wizadmin (/api/auth/me returned wizadmin), GET /api/settings confirmed show_tagline/host_names/show_description/audience saved. Then wiped users again, loaded 'Restore a backup' from /tmp/bb_backup.zip (325KB), setup-restore-done appeared, 'Go to sign in' button navigated to /login, admin/<redacted> logged in successfully. Dashboard Upcoming panel verified via UI: created 5 plan items (yesterday no-ep -> Overdue, in-5 draft-ep -> Behind schedule, in-10 no-ep -> Not started, in-40 no-ep -> On track, past date linked to published ep -> hidden). All flags matched expected text exactly. 'N need attention' showed '4 need attention'. backup-download-btn visible for admin, confirmed hidden for producer (producer login had no selector match). Library (/episodes): checkbox row selects, selection bar renders, library-add-to-series-btn opens add-to-series-dialog, choosing 'No series' creates TEST_IT4_LibSeries via POST /api/series + POST /api/series/{id}/episodes, series badge renders with color dot + name, library-series-filter restricts to that series, library-remove-from-series-btn clears the badge. Full regression run: 71 passed (32 backend_test.py + 15 test_iteration2.py + 12 test_iteration4.py + 12 iteration3 cases that don't need the RSS http.server fixture); 6 iteration3 failures are environment-only (require `python3 -m http.server 8099` in /app/tests/rss_fixture — not an app bug, documented in iteration3 context). Final state: admin/<redacted> works, wizadmin removed by restore, all TEST_IT4_* episodes/plans/series removed, it4_frontprod producer deactivated, podcast info test fields blanked, 'The God Who Sees' episode preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/setup.py cleanly separates needs_setup gate, SETUP_TOKEN check, backup zip builder (manifest + db/*.json + media/) and restore_zip (validates app id + presence of admin). Good.
restore_zip strips media/ paths against MEDIA_DIR root via resolve() + parent check to prevent zip-slip. Correct.
/api/setup auto-logs-in via set_auth_cookies on the created admin — matches wizard UX requirement.
/api/backup/restore (admin-authenticated) explicitly deletes access_token/refresh_token cookies after restoring — correct because the user accounts list is replaced wholesale.
planner.add_episodes_to_series uses upsert-style update_one then insert_one; MOVE semantics (single plan item per episode) verified. Good.

UpcomingPanel.scheduleFlag correctly places 'ready' check BEFORE 'overdue', so past items with published/script_complete status are tagged 'ready' and then filtered out by the days>=0 || flag==overdue filter. Logic verified end-to-end.
Setup wizard validation gates (admin.password === admin.confirm, min lengths, podcast.show_name required) correctly disable Next/Finish. Good.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 iteration-4; 71/77 full regression — the 6 failures are iteration-3 RSS tests that require an external fixture http.server on :8099 and are not iteration-4 regressions)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of iteration-4 critical flows (setup fresh, setup restore, dashboard upcoming all 4 flags + hidden ready, backup button role gating, library add-to-series + badge + filter + remove)

seed_data_creation: During run: wizadmin/<redacted> (removed by restore), TEST_IT4_* episodes/plans/series (deleted post-run), it4_frontprod producer (deactivated), TEST_IT4_PAST_PUB published episode + plan_item (deleted). Backup zip at /tmp/bb_backup.zip (325KB) retained for next-agent re-use.
